requests.validation_evidence: Simulator Try It Out and Postman: GET on the local books collection, status 200 and a JSON array of book objects (id, title, author). Response evidence/R1_list_books.json.

requests.purpose: List books with ISBN values and sort by author
requests.validation_evidence: Postman Params tab with includeISBN=true and sortBy=author, status 200, every object now carries an isbn field and the list is ordered by author. Compared against R1 to confirm both parameters changed the response. Response evidence/R2_isbn_sorted.json.

requests.purpose: Authenticate and obtain a temporary API token

headers.Authorization: Basic <redacted, generated by Postman from lab-only credentials>

requests.validation_evidence: Postman Authorization tab set to Basic Auth with the instructor-provided lab credentials, status 200, response body contains a token field whose value is fully blurred. Response evidence/R3_login_basic.json.
Postman Body set to raw JSON with the fictional record, X-API-KEY header value blurred, status 200 and a response echoing the new book. Response evidence/R4_add_book.json.

requests.purpose: Retrieve the newly added book by ID
requests.validation_evidence: Postman GET with the fictional ID from R4 in the path, status 200, returned title and author match the R4 payload exactly. Response evidence/R5_get_book_by_id.json.

requests.purpose: Delete the newly added book by ID
requests.validation_evidence: Postman DELETE with the fictional ID and the X-API-KEY header value blurred, status 200. Repeating R5 afterwards no longer returns the book, which confirms the cleanup. Response evidence/R6_delete_book.json.

requests.purpose: Troubleshoot a rejected add-book request with a missing or invalid API key

payload.title: Packets Beneath the Acacia, Second Printing
payload.author: Lorna Villaverde

requests.validation_evidence: Postman R4 duplicate with the X-API-KEY header unticked returns 401; re-enabled with a deliberately altered key also returns 401. Restoring the valid key from R3 returns 200, and the book is then deleted as in R6. Response evidence/R7_401_missing_key.json and evidence/R7_fixed_200.json.
